differences.what: A's residual table lists each edge's orthogonal residual subspace (B tensor t_X-perp, P tensor F, etc.) together with its dimension; B S3.2.5 lists only the dimensions.

A derives that stage outputs equal the next stage's inputs (A'=A tensor F, P'=P tensor <t>, B'=(B tensor F) perp (P tensor t-perp)); B only asserts it.

items.note: Both carry L1-L5 with nothing wrong. A gives the residual subspaces and the stage-fit derivation, and B adds the alternating-plane absorption, so on balance A is slightly fuller.

Both give individual kernels at O(Ve), s children per node, O(V((eK)^tau+1)) overhead, the q_0-chunk row index with padding, the V/W children, the recurrence with leaves at e<d^beta, the internal and leaf sums, and the base-m pieces giving O(d^{lambda'}) (A S4.3a-j; B S5.1.10-14).

A gives the round schedule (h=l-1 on the long axes, then the qK chunk rounds, then the prefix slots), so all participating axes share the current length 2^{h+1}; B lacks it.

differences.what: B's root step concludes that n log n is not the optimal order of multitape multiplication; A never states the refutation. Neither gives the liminf argument.

items.note: A supporting item. B at least states the disproving conclusion that A omits, though without the paper's reasoning.

chain.note: Both trees follow the paper's route. They take the fixed networks with total edge rank s<Wm (labels with L<N/2, then the bit shear and complex phase interfaces) to the deficits eta_b, eta_c and tau=sigma=1-2^{-50}, then through the recurrence F_k<=(s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1) to O(Ve^tau) interchange and O(Vd^{lambda'}) layers. Both then reach the transform, convolution, resampling, multiplication, exact-recovery and cost-table steps, ending at min g_i=2kappa. Neither chain thins out or breaks where the other does not.

overall.reason: I found no misstatement of the paper in either plan, and both chains for the central saving are complete and faithful. The difference is completeness within core derivations, all in A's favour. A alone carries checklist sub-step P3, the decimation-in-frequency identity and the derivation of F_t^+B_t^{-1} in the synthetic transform, the common-frame identity D_out S_Omega D_in^{-1}, and the proofs behind coefficient extraction and the convolution error. B's only advantage is stating the conjecture's refutation, a supporting item, without its argument.
